description: This file contains a PHP test class for the User API in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing various API endpoints related to user management such as getAll, getOne, create, and update. It extends a test framework class and utilizes mock services and fixtures for testing.

classes.name: UserAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the User API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. Implements setup routines and multiple test cases for CRUD operations and retrieval functions on user data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating specific database tables related to OpenID providers.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for retrieving all users using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for retrieving a single user based on test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a user via API with mocked dependencies and fixtures.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for create user endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating user information via API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for updating a user.

methods.name: enableSocialMediaAuthPreHook
methods.description: Enables social media authentication by activating an OpenID provider in the database.
